module_summary: PS/2-style packet framer: a 4-state FSM finds message starts via in[3] and counts three bytes, while a 24-bit shift register captures them.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Tracks byte position (BYTE1, BYTE2, BYTE3, DONE) within a 3-byte message.

anchors.name: out_bytes_r
anchors.why: 24-bit shift register holding the last three input bytes.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Asserted in DONE state; qualifies out_bytes as a complete message.

anchors.name: in3
anchors.why: Bit 3 of input byte marks a message start; drives FSM transitions.

anchors.name: out_bytes
anchors.why: 24-bit message output, valid only when done.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Input byte stream shifted into the message register.

groups.name: framing_fsm
groups.description: Message-boundary FSM using in[3] to start, counting three bytes.

groups.name: message_shift_register
groups.description: Shifts in bytes and presents the 24-bit message on done.
